Approved, it is a fourth kind of claim in the Bank (free tokens = balance − grants − asks − reservations − retainers), shown on the Bank page and GET /api/bank as its own line and on each schedule card (per run, runs left, drawn). Each fire runs in lane "retainer" with the schedule as its source, drawing on that claim; a run at its per-run amount wraps up. Pausing past the end, cancelling or the last run releases the unspent claim; raising the amount or extending the end re-asks; renewal is a new ask. Built behind decision 1 so amounts are in Opus units from day one; sc_nx8bwd5e5o is re-cut onto a retainer once live.
